title: PACSAB Server: A Web-Based Tool for the Study of Aggregation and the Conformational Ensemble of Disordered and Folded Proteins.
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍PACSAB服务器，用粗粒化模型模拟无序和折叠蛋白的构象系综及聚集倾向，虽聚焦单蛋白聚集而非直接PPI，但方法对IDP构象和互作机制建模有可迁移价值。
abstract: We present in this article the PACSAB server, which is designed to provide information about the structural ensemble and interactions of both stable and disordered proteins to researchers in the field of molecular biology. The use of this tool does not require any computational skills as the user just needs to upload the structure of the protein to be studied; the server runs a simulation with the PACSAB model, a highly accurate coarse-grained model that is much more efficient than standard molecular dynamics for the exploration of the conformational space of multiprotein systems. The trajectories generated by the simulations based on this model reveal the propensity of the protein under study for aggregation, identify the residues playing a central role in the aggregation process, and reproduce the whole conformational space of disordered proteins. All of this information is shown and can be downloaded from the web page.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了PACSAB服务器，旨在为分子生物学领域的研究人员提供关于稳定及无序蛋白质的结构ensemble和相互作用信息。使用此工具无需任何计算技能，用户只需上传待研究蛋白质的结构；服务器将使用PACSAB模型进行模拟，这是一种高精度的粗粒化模型，在探索多蛋白系统的构象空间方面比标准分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 更为高效。基于该模型的模拟生成的轨迹揭示了所研究蛋白质的聚集倾向，识别了在聚集过程中起核心作用的残基，并重现了无序蛋白质的整个构象空间。所有这些信息均可在网页上展示并下载。
